infothequecore-desc: Guided forms for structured Infothèque content (downloads, manuals, configurations, drivers)
infothequecore-select-form-help: Choose which kind of table you want to add or edit.
infothequecore-field-titre-help: Leave empty for the default title ("Archived versions of [page name]").
infothequecore-field-description-help: Free notes. For a serial number/product key, use the dedicated field instead of typing it here.
infothequecore-field-format-media-help: Pick the icon file representing the medium (floppy, CD, ISO...) — the wiki link is generated automatically.
infothequecore-field-liens-help: One link per line, formatted as [url text]. Multiple links are shown as a bulleted list.
infothequecore-field-format-document-hel: Pick the icon file representing the document type (PDF, image...) — the wiki link is generated automatically.
infothequecore-field-fichier-pilote-help: The file must already be uploaded to the wiki (Tools menu > Upload file).
infothequecore-field-target-page-help: The wiki page this table will be published to.
infothequecore-page-exists-warning: The page "$1" already exists. This assistant doesn't merge content into an existing page yet: copy the wikitext above and paste it yourself at the right spot.
infothequecore-invalid-target-page: The target page name is not valid.
infothequecore-bad-token: Invalid security token, please try again.
infothequecore-confirm-missing-data: Missing data to publish, please start again from the form.
infothequecore-save-failed: Publishing failed. Check your edit rights and try again.
infothequecore-error-no-rows: Add at least one row before continuing.
infothequecore-insert-context-existing: Editing the existing table on: $1 — current rows have been pre-filled below.
infothequecore-insert-hint: Nothing is saved to the wiki yet: this window will close and the result will be placed in the editor. Review it, then save the page yourself.
